name: Press front
description: A hard cut to a newspaper front page: masthead, date line, a big headline and an italic deck, columns of small text, and the speaker in the middle as a live halftone photo, still talking. A pull quote and a contents list sit under it. The page creeps in slowly.
when: When your news or claim deserves a headline: a launch, a result, 'this made the front page'.
needs: the column text, quote, contents and caption
the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
the halftone data (lum.js, made in the steps)
